item.title: Adéla Performs at Global Mixtape During Grammy Week 2026 - KRUTO MEDIA
item.description: Slovakian singer-songwriter Adéla took the stage at the Global Mixtape showcase during Grammy Week. The event, part of the expanded Grammy House programming, highlighted rising international artists. Adéla performed alongside Palestinian-British artist Hajaj and Mexican indie act Paloma Morphy, with the evening hosted by Grammy winner Tony Succar.
